sections.heading: Welcome
sections.text: Welcome to our store. We believe in quality, design, and sustainable practices.

sections.heading: Our History
sections.text: Founded in 2026, we aim to bring you the best curated fashion.

sections.heading: Rates & Times
sections.text: Free standard shipping on orders over $75. Standard delivery takes 5-7 business days.

sections.heading: International
sections.text: We ship internationally. Rates and transit times are calculated at checkout based on your destination.

sections.heading: Data Protection
sections.text: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. We do not sell your information to third parties.

sections.heading: Agreement
sections.text: By using this website, you agree to our terms of service and conditions of sale.

sections.heading: How do I return an item?
sections.text: Reach out to returns@yourbrand.com within 30 days of delivery.

sections.heading: When will my order ship?
sections.text: Orders typically process within 1-2 business days before shipping.
